scope: One reader architecture after fixed accepted joint evidence selection. Same final admitted original sources; no new retrieval, candidate selection, model substitution, context expansion or source rewriting.

source.mechanism: content_selection followed by fusion_in_context or sentence generation; adapt to English short answers with exact source-substring validation. Not a full reproduction or a claim that their LFQA results transfer.

development: all160 exposed official MuSiQue train questions in evidence-set-20261023/development-prepared-3; shared support text groups143

profiles.direct256_prior: Historical diagnostic only: reuse exact unchanged message/config outcomes from prior set_rank5; not the primary contemporaneous control.
profiles.direct768: Current live control, original messages,768 maximum output tokens, JSON short-answer output, no span preparation.
profiles.attribute512_answer256: Fixed candidate:512-token exact source quotation selection, local span check, annotate existing records,256-token answer; total768 maximum output. Keep ALL original sources/refs/snippets/metadata unchanged and same8000 evidence cap.

prompt_policy: One source-based span-selection instruction and one fixed answer suffix; no few-shot dataset examples or prompt sweep. No gold answer/decomposition/hop IDs sent to reader.
budget: Same8000 RAG units and16384 context, conservative byte estimator, each request admitted. Candidate two requests can consume more actual tokens/latency; equal output caps are not equal realized compute.
primary: attribute512_answer256 minus direct768 official aliases token F1, all planned failures retained0
api_policy: One attempt per stage, fixed model,temp0,thinking disabled,JSON-object mode. Wrong model/unknown/non400 provider error stops. First candidate pair must fully succeed before batch. Invalid>5% answers stops. Known400/invalid spans/budget fallback explicitly reuse identical original direct256 outcome, including failures; no successful request is retried. Keep separate actual paid and logical pipeline cost accounts.
span_validation: up to8 quotations,8..600 characters each,total<=2000; original snippet exact substring, original chunk_id, server-computed offsets. Existence is not entailment or relevance. Empty/invalid quotes do not become factual notes.
statistics: One fixed primary, question-weighted paired5000 bootstrap over prior shared support text groups; strata descriptive, no method selection by hops or gold labels.
confirmation: Only if allDEV gates pass:freeze one method, sample at most200 never-exposed official dev questions excluding prior700dev IDs and160train support-title/text families. Require>=120 eligible or report confirmation unavailable. Sampling size/eligibility not by outcomes; no reusing old200 as blind and no method reselection. If DEV fails, no new confirmation exposure.
stop: One candidate/one DEV/at most one frozen confirmation; no prompt or budget reselection. Preserve negative outcomes. No default/business AgentVersion change on DEV alone.

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
